workflows.title: Automated Invoice Anomaly Detection & ERP Reconciliation
workflows.description: Ingests vendor accounts payable invoices, parses line items via Gemini OCR, detects variance anomalies, and auto-posts compliant entries to SAP.

ai_metadata.workflow_title: Automated Invoice Anomaly Detection & ERP Reconciliation
ai_metadata.risk_assessment: Low risk. Automatic human-in-the-loop escalation triggered for variance discrepancies exceeding 5% or $10,000 threshold.

steps.expected_output: Structured JSON payload with normalized supplier IDs, PO reference, and tax subtotals.
steps.execution_output: 142 incoming invoices normalized. 100% field extraction confidence.

steps.action_name: Three-Way Matching against Open Purchase Orders & Receipt Slips
steps.expected_output: Line-by-line price and quantity variance matrix.
steps.execution_output: Matched 139 invoices cleanly. 3 invoices flagged for price discrepancy ($4,120 net variance).

steps.action_name: Audit Trail Signature & SAP Journal Entry Auto-Post
steps.expected_output: ERP transaction reference ID and immutable cryptographic audit timestamp.
steps.execution_output: Entries committed to SAP S/4HANA (Batch ID #SAP-88219). Clean audit receipt generated.

execution_logs: Workflow triggered on scheduled procurement cycle.
OCR parser extracted line items with 99.2% accuracy.
Audit trail written with SHA-256 batch signature.
